# openwebui_ldap_config (Resource)

Manages Open WebUI LDAP enable toggle. This is a singleton resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_ldap_config" "example" {
  enable_ldap = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enable_ldap` (Boolean) Whether LDAP authentication is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier.
